title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：shock　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shock 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the elder ① felt the shock that no youth in the village would have described, and he said the feeling was the whole of the year. The ② shock, meaning the blow itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a shock, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ shock in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ shock at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shock, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the elder said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shock was the whole of the matter, meaning the fear and not the blow. The ⑥ shock, meaning the fear and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; shock, he said, is either something you feel or the only word that means both a blow and a fear. He said the fear is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ shock had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ shock of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of describing; shock, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shock I remember is the blow described in the memoir, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ shock, my mother said in 1991, is the only blow that improves by being described; every shock, she said, is a fear that has agreed to look like a blow. She said the fear was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 震惊；冲击（指村子里每一阵旁边的那一阵）
B. n. 震惊；冲击（指那阵震惊本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：feel the shock 感到这一阵震惊
D. n. 震惊；冲击（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 震惊之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的震惊之事）
F. n. 震惊；冲击（指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一阵）
G. n. 震惊、惊惧（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惊惧（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: felt the shock that no youth in the village would have described
The shock, meaning the blow itself and not the staff
the shock at the far gate
the shock was the whole of the matter
the shock had become a line in a memoir
The shock of the whole thing
A shock, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: feel the shock 意为“感到这一阵震惊”，1982 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯描述的一阵震惊做了一遍。
shock 意为“震惊；冲击”，指那阵震惊本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
shock 意为“震惊；冲击”，指村子里每一阵旁边的那一阵，每一阵旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
shock 意为“震惊；冲击”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shock 意为“震惊、惊惧”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵惊惧就是那件事的全部。
shock 意为“惊惧”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵震惊，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shock 意为“震惊；冲击”，指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一阵，到 1987 年这一阵成了回忆录里的一行。
shock 意为“震惊之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的震惊之事是一处村子和三个年头的描述。
shock 意为“震惊；冲击”，我记得的是回忆录里描述过的那一阵，1989 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一阵。
shock 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，震惊是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的震惊。
